description: Lite.CUAGym grounded teacher trajectories collected on CUA-Gym task bundles and reward functions via the cua-lite `lite.cuagym` runtime, from two teachers published as separate configs (`*.gpt5_5` from gpt-5.5, `*.qwen3_8_27b` from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B) and annotated by the same quality pass; trajectories kept except /opt/env and OOB-coordinate hard-drops, quality gates tagged in metadata.others.exclude_reason (filter with not exclude_reason and episode_return>0.5)
